def _get_publish(self):
        """
        Find this publish on remote
        """
        # Get the publish path from the asset
        publish_path = self._get_publish_path()

        # Get the current user
        current_user = self.api.Session["AVALON_USER"]

        # Get the current project
        project = self.api.Session["AVALON_PROJECT"]

        # Get the remote project
        remote_project = self._get_remote_project()

        # Get the remote publish path
        remote_publish_path = os.path.join(
            remote_project, "publish", current_user, publish_path)

        # Get the remote publish
        remote_publish = self.api.get(remote_publish_path)

        return remote_publish
